tools.name: geocode_address
tools.description: Convert an address string to latitude and longitude coordinates. Uses hybrid geocoding (Google Maps API with Nominatim fallback) for accurate results.

address.description: Address to geocode (e.g., "Waterloo, Ontario" or "123 Main St, Toronto, ON")

tools.name: calculate_local_food_score
tools.description: Calculate the Local Food Score for a given address or coordinates. Returns a score from 0-100 with three factors: how local, easy to get, and covers a diet. Only counts food grown within 100 km that is reachable through channels in the search radius.

address.description: Address to calculate score for (e.g., "610 Sandringham Dr, Waterloo, Ontario"). Use either address or coordinates, not both.

latitude.description: Latitude coordinate (use with longitude instead of address)

longitude.description: Longitude coordinate (use with latitude instead of address)

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers (default: 8, min: 1, max: 30)

tools.name: geocode_place
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Detect and set GPS coordinates for a place by geocoding its existing address. Useful for fixing places missing coordinates or correcting inaccurate ones.

participant_id.description: ID of the place to geocode

force_redetect.description: Force re-detection even if place already has coordinates (useful for correcting wrong coordinates)

tools.name: link_google_place
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Search Google Places for a Piknik place and optionally store its googlePlaceId after human review. Returns ranked candidates with 0-100 match scores and score breakdowns (name, address, status, type, proximity). Default action is search. Linking requires an explicit google_place_id unless auto_select is true.

participant_id.description: Piknik participant ID to link. Required for action=link.

business_name.description: Business name to search. Defaults to the participant name when participant_id is provided.

address.description: Address to search. Defaults to the participant address when participant_id is provided.

google_place_id.description: Google Place ID chosen by a human reviewer. Required for action=link unless auto_select is true.

action.description: search returns Google candidates for human review; link stores the chosen match on the participant.

auto_select.description: When true, link may pick the top Google candidate automatically if it meets min_confidence. Default false — human should pass google_place_id.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence required only when auto_select is true.

force.description: Relink even if the participant already has a validated Google Place ID.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return for action=search.

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search for local food events, farmers markets, workshops, and community gatherings. Respects EVENT_SYSTEM feature flag. Can search by address string or coordinates.

query.description: Search query for event title or description

address.description: Address to search near (e.g., "Waterloo, Ontario"). If provided, will geocode and use for location filtering. Alternative to providing location coordinates.

location.description: Location coordinates. Use either address or location, not both.

start_date.description: Filter events starting after this date (ISO format)

end_date.description: Filter events ending before this date (ISO format)

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return

tools.name: get_analytics_metrics
tools.description: Get analytics and business intelligence metrics for the food system. Admin access required.

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Search for active gamification challenges and geographic games. Respects GAMIFICATION_SYSTEM feature flag.

tools.name: find_places
tools.description: Find existing places based on location, preferences, and context. Combines multiple recommendation engines for comprehensive results.

address.description: Address to search around (e.g., "123 Main St, Toronto, ON" or "Toronto, Ontario")

context.description: Context for suggestions (e.g., "dinner ingredients", "weekend farmers market", "organic produce", "local honey")

tools.name: suggest_place
tools.description: Analyze location coverage gaps and create a new place suggestion. ONLY use this when there is verifiable evidence (such as a website, business registry, or direct confirmation) of the physical business existence. Do NOT make assumptions or suggest unverified places. Returns participant_id in the response when authenticated with business_name

address.description: Address to analyze (e.g., "123 Main St, Toronto, ON" or "Toronto, Ontario")

context.description: Context for the new business (e.g., "farmers market", "organic grocery", "local bakery")

business_name.description: Proposed name for the new business

business_address.description: Full street address for the business (e.g., "3320 First Ave, Vineland, ON L0R 2E0"). Use the farm or shop location, not a region placeholder like "Waterloo Region, ON".

business_type.description: Type of business to analyze for

website.description: Business website URL (shown on the public place page when approved)

tools.name: get_professional_profile
tools.description: Get professional networking profile information. Respects PROFESSIONAL_NETWORKING feature flag.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Search marketplace listings for items to buy, sell, or services offered. Find products and services available in the local food system.

query.description: Search query for listing title or description (e.g., "organic carrots", "fresh milk", "delivery service")

address.description: Address to search near (e.g., "Waterloo, Ontario"). Will geocode and filter by distance.

location.description: Location coordinates. Use either address or location, not both.

limit.description: Maximum number of listings to return

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Create a new marketplace listing (wanted to buy, wanted to sell, or service offering). Requires OAuth authentication with marketplace:write scope.

participant_id.description: The ID of your place creating the listing (get from get_my_places)

title.description: Title of the listing (e.g., "Organic Carrots Available", "Looking for Fresh Milk")

quantity.description: Quantity available or needed (e.g., "50 lbs", "10 boxes", "3 bushels")

radius_km.description: Service radius in kilometers (how far you are willing to sell/buy within)

end_date.description: When the listing expires (ISO date format, e.g., "2026-02-15")

association_ids.description: Optional: IDs of associations this listing is affiliated with

wanted_in_return.description: Optional: What you're seeking in exchange (e.g., "fresh eggs", "vegetables", "delivery help"). Enables barter/trade matching.

offering_id.description: Optional: link to a place offering (STAPLE or COMPOSED) owned by participant_id

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Create a new event (farmers market, workshop, community gathering, etc.). Requires OAuth authentication with events:write scope. Respects EVENT_SYSTEM feature flag. Events can be created with or without a participant (place) association.

participant_id.description: Optional: The ID of your place creating the event (get from get_my_places). If omitted, creates a standalone event not tied to any business.

title.description: Event title (e.g., "Weekly Farmers Market", "Organic Farming Workshop")

start_date.description: Event start date and time (ISO format)

end_date.description: Event end date and time (ISO format)

location_name.description: Name of the event location (e.g., "Waterloo Public Square")

address.description: Full address of the event location

is_recurring.description: Whether this is a recurring event

weekly_days.description: Weekly recurrence days (e.g., ["monday", "thursday"]). Preferred over recurrence_rule when both are set.

recurrence_end_date.description: Last date for recurring instances (ISO format, e.g., end of academic term)

registration_url.description: URL for event registration or more info

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Update an existing event. Requires OAuth authentication with events:write scope. Can update event details, times, location, or status.

event_id.description: The ID of the event to update

start_date.description: Updated event start date and time (ISO format with timezone, e.g., "2026-03-15T10:00:00-05:00")

end_date.description: Updated event end date and time (ISO format with timezone)

tools.name: get_my_places
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Get list of places (farms, restaurants, markets) that the authenticated user owns or has access to manage. Useful for finding participant_id to use with update_place, create_listing, or create_event.

tools.name: update_place
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Update a place (farm, restaurant, market) that you own or manage. Allows updating profile information like name, description, address, contact details, operating hours, and more. Admin users can also update status.

participant_id.description: ID of the place to update (get from get_my_places)

orderUrl.description: Online order / shop URL shown as Order Online on the public place page

csaSignupUrl.description: CSA subscription signup URL shown as Join CSA on the public place page

tourNarration.description: Spoken/read walking-tour script for this place (Participant.tourNarration). Used on association place tours. Pass empty string to clear.

image.description: Public photo URL for this place (profile and tour stops). Pass empty string to clear. Prefer a photo they published. To upload a file: Dashboard → Places or Admin → Places (site admins and place managers).

offersCsa.description: Whether this farm offers CSA (Community Supported Agriculture)

customEmoji.description: Custom emoji icon for the place (e.g., 🚜 for farms, 🏪 for markets, 🍴 for restaurants)

primaryRole.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Correct business role (e.g. FARM → PROCESSOR for a meat packer misclassified as a farm)

status.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Change place status. DRAFT=not published, ACTIVE=visible to all, INACTIVE=hidden, PRIVATE=only visible to owner/admins

latitude.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Manually set latitude coordinate (overrides geocoding)

longitude.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Manually set longitude coordinate (overrides geocoding)

metadata_notes.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Public Details notes shown on the place page (metadata.notes). Pass empty string to clear internal suggestion notes.

marketKind.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: For MARKET places — retail (farmers market, default) or exchange (wholesale produce auction hub like EPAC). Exchange markets use ↔️ on the map and can supply processors.

narrative_tags.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Internal narrative flavor tags that guide the Local Food Score narrative PDF (stored on metadata.narrativeTags). Not shown on the public place page. Pass [] to clear. Allowed: hidden-gem, family-run, longtime-staple, back-roads, destination, weekend-ritual, newcomer, maker, iconic, agritourism, aggregator, stall-vendor, small-community, small-hub.

quality_claims.description: Farm-wide producer-stated quality claims (ParticipantTag CERTIFICATION). Inherited by all offerings. Pass [] to clear. Allowed: ethically_raised, hormone_free, environmentally_friendly, non_gmo, nutrient_dense, antibiotic_free, organic.

businessType.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Merchant business type (e.g. Bakery, Grocery). Sets merchantProfile.businessType for map display and maker/bakery detection in Local Food Score narratives.

supplierCount.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Self-declared number of local sources for the hub tier badge (metadata.supplierCount). Tiers: 1-2=Local Source, 3-5=Local Hub, 6-10=Regional Hub, 10+=Major Hub. Pass 0 to clear.

tools.name: claim_delivery_task
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Claim a delivery coordination task. Caller must have a participant with canDeliver: true.

task_id.description: ID of the delivery task to claim

tools.name: update_delivery_status
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Update delivery task status with optional GPS. Caller must be the user who claimed the task.

tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Search for products and offerings across all places (farms, restaurants, processors). Find what products are available, where, and at what price.

latitude.description: Center latitude for distance search (e.g., 43.4643 for Waterloo, ON)

longitude.description: Center longitude for distance search (e.g., -80.5204 for Waterloo, ON)

query.description: Search text to match product name or description

offering_type.description: Filter by offering type (SUBSCRIPTION for CSA programs)

allows_pickup.description: Only show offerings that allow pickup

allows_delivery.description: Only show offerings that allow delivery

sort_by.description: Sort results by distance, price, or name

group_by.description: Group results by individual offering or by place

tools.name: list_all_places
tools.description: List all places (farms, markets, restaurants, community gardens) within a radius of coordinates. Get full inventory of participants in an area.

primary_role.description: Filter by place type(s). Use "all" for all types, single string, or array of types (e.g., ["FARM", "MARKET"])

include_distance.description: Include distance from center in results

format.description: Response format. Use "json" for structured place records.

tools.name: list_service_locations
tools.description: List all service locations (pickup points, delivery hubs) for a specific place. Service locations can be used for CSA pickups, farmers market stalls, delivery points, etc.

participant_id.description: ID of the place to list service locations for

purpose.description: Filter by purpose. Aliases FARMERS_MARKET, DELIVERY_HUB, and PICKUP_POINT are accepted.

tools.name: create_service_location
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Create a new service location (CSA pickup point, farmers market stall, delivery hub) for your place. Address will be auto-geocoded.

participant_id.description: ID of your place (get from get_my_places)

name.description: Location name (e.g., Downtown Pickup, Tuesday Market Stall)

purpose.description: Purpose(s). Canonical: CSA_PICKUP, MARKET_STALL, DELIVERY_DROPOFF, SECONDARY_LOCATION. Aliases: FARMERS_MARKET→MARKET_STALL, DELIVERY_HUB→DELIVERY_DROPOFF, PICKUP_POINT→SECONDARY_LOCATION.

tools.name: update_service_location
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Update an existing service location. Only provide fields to change.

location_id.description: ID of location to update (get from list_service_locations)

purpose.description: Purpose(s). Aliases FARMERS_MARKET, DELIVERY_HUB, and PICKUP_POINT are accepted.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List products/offerings for a place, including kind, paused state, and pack sell prices (ways they sell: kg, eighth, etc.). Use create_pack_price to add sell packs on STAPLE offerings.

category.description: Filter by category (e.g., vegetables, fruit, meat, dairy)

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the shared product catalog by name or alias. Returns product_id values to pass to create_product. No authentication required.

category.description: Optional category filter (e.g., vegetables, fruit, meat, dairy, eggs)

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Create a place offering. kind=STAPLE (default): catalog food via product_id. kind=COMPOSED: named package/dish with optional ingredients[{source_id,product_id}]. Do NOT use price/price_unit for how the farm sells packs — after creating a STAPLE, call create_pack_price (e.g. 10 kg or 1 eighth). Use source_url for the shop/product page link — never put URLs in description. Use is_available=false to pause. Only with verifiable evidence. Use list_products / search_products first.

participant_id.description: ID of your place (get from get_my_places)

kind.description: STAPLE = catalog food; COMPOSED = named hybrid using ingredients

product_id.description: Required for STAPLE: ID from search_products.

name.description: STAPLE: catalog name if no product_id. COMPOSED: sellable title (required).

source_url.description: Online shop / product page URL for this offering. Do NOT put URLs in description. Pass empty string to clear on update.

price.description: Deprecated for STAPLE sell packs — use create_pack_price instead

price_unit.description: Deprecated for STAPLE sell packs — use create_pack_price instead

production_method.description: How the product is produced. GREENHOUSE, HYDROPONIC, and INDOOR count toward regional greenhouse / fresh winter produce scoring.

tags.description: Freeform tags (e.g. local, community-verified). Prefer quality_claims for Organic / Hormone Free / etc.

quality_claims.description: Optional producer-stated quality claims stored on the offering. Pass [] to clear. Allowed: ethically_raised, hormone_free, environmentally_friendly, non_gmo, nutrient_dense, antibiotic_free, organic.

tools.name: update_product
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Update an offering. Use is_available to pause/resume. Use source_url for the shop/product page link — never put URLs in description. For STAPLE sell prices (10 kg, ⅛ animal, etc.) use create_pack_price / update_pack_price / delete_pack_price — not price/price_unit.

source_url.description: Online shop / product page URL for this offering. Do NOT put URLs in description. Pass empty string to clear.

ingredients.description: COMPOSED: replace ingredient list when provided

price.description: Deprecated for STAPLE packs — use pack price tools

price_unit.description: Deprecated for STAPLE packs — use pack price tools

is_available.description: false = paused (not for sale); true = resume

production_method.description: How the product is produced. GREENHOUSE, HYDROPONIC, and INDOOR count toward regional greenhouse scoring. Pass empty string to clear.

tags.description: Freeform tags. Prefer quality_claims for Organic / Hormone Free / etc.

quality_claims.description: Optional producer-stated quality claims. Merged into offering tags; pass [] to clear claims. Allowed: ethically_raised, hormone_free, environmentally_friendly, non_gmo, nutrient_dense, antibiotic_free, organic.

tools.name: fetch_ontario_farms
tools.description: Fetch Ontario farm/agri-business records from government open data for populating Piknik. Returns OMAFRA-licensed meat and dairy plants (individual business records with addresses) plus census mid-tier farm counts by county ($100k–$999k receipts, 2021). Does NOT read from existing Piknik data.

format.description: Response format. Use "json" for structured farm records.

tools.name: fetch_ontario_grocery_retailers
tools.description: Fetch active Ontario grocery and convenience retailers from AGCO open data. Classifies each by consumer capacity tier (minimal gas/convenience vs community grocer vs regional chain) using licence type and premises type.

format.description: Response format. Use "json" for structured retailer records.

tools.name: get_regional_food_improvements
tools.description: Analyze a region for food score gaps and ranked improvement opportunities (connect farms to shops, document inventory, onboard producers, infrastructure). Returns the same JSON as GET /api/regional-score/analyze.

region_id.description: Region participant ID (use region_id or region_slug, not both required)

format.description: Response format. Use "json" for full structured analyze payload.

tools.name: suggest_connection
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Propose a supplier→buyer sourcing link for admin review (does NOT change scores until approved). ONLY use this when there is verifiable evidence (such as a website link, official registry, or direct confirmation) of the commercial relationship. Do NOT make assumptions or suggest unverified connections. Supplier: FARM, PROCESSOR, COMMUNITY_GARDEN, MERCHANT (shop hop, discovery only), or MARKET with marketKind exchange. Buyer: RESTAURANT, MERCHANT, MARKET, FARM, or FOOD_BANK. Non-admins use this; admins use apply_connection for immediate links.

supplier_id.description: Supplier participant ID (FARM, PROCESSOR, COMMUNITY_GARDEN, MERCHANT, or exchange MARKET)

buyer_id.description: Buyer participant ID (RESTAURANT, MERCHANT, MARKET, FARM, or FOOD_BANK)

products.description: Optional list of products involved in the connection

note.description: Optional note explaining why this connection makes sense

region_id.description: Optional regional score region ID for attribution

source_opportunity_id.description: Optional source opportunity ID from regional score analysis

tools.name: apply_connection
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Create or update a live supplier→buyer sourcing link. ONLY use this when there is verifiable evidence (such as a website link, official registry, or direct confirmation) of the commercial relationship. Do NOT make assumptions or create unverified connections. Supplier: FARM, PROCESSOR, COMMUNITY_GARDEN, MERCHANT (shop hop, discovery only), or MARKET with marketKind exchange. Buyer: RESTAURANT, MERCHANT, MARKET, FARM, FOOD_BANK, or PROCESSOR. Farm and processor supplier links affect Local Food Score (processor chains include upstream farms and exchange hubs). Shop hops do not.

supplier_id.description: Supplier participant ID (FARM, PROCESSOR, COMMUNITY_GARDEN, MERCHANT, or exchange MARKET)

buyer_id.description: Buyer participant ID (RESTAURANT, MERCHANT, MARKET, FARM, or FOOD_BANK)

products.description: Optional product categories for this link (e.g. ["Grains", "flour"])

tools.name: remove_connection
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Remove a live supplier→buyer sourcing link.

tools.name: suggest_product
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Suggest a new product/offering for an existing place. ONLY use this when there is verifiable evidence (such as a website menu, farm guide, or direct confirmation) that the place actually offers this product. Do NOT make assumptions or suggest unverified products. Creates a pending suggestion for admin review — does not require place ownership.

participant_id.description: ID of the place to add the product to

product_id.description: Preferred: ID from search_products. Ensures nutrient mapping and blocks non-local items.

name.description: Product name — must match catalog or local food vocabulary (required if product_id omitted)

notes.description: Optional notes about the source or evidence for this suggestion

tools.name: notify_participants
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Send welcome/onboarding emails to newly added participants (farms, gardens, etc.). Use this to notify businesses that they're now on Piknik and can claim their spot.

participant_ids.description: Array of participant IDs to notify (get from list_all_places or search results)

include_claim_link.description: Whether to include a claim link in the email (default: true)

tools.name: list_neighborhoods
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: List Waterloo Region neighborhoods (optional municipality filter). Each row includes id, label, kind, municipality, GPS, benchmark price (CAD), DOM, and previousPrice when set. Missing housing fields show as n/a. Structured result.neighborhoods has the full objects.

tools.name: add_neighborhood
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Add a neighborhood to the catalog. Response includes benchmark price, DOM, and previousPrice when provided.

label.description: The display name of the neighborhood (e.g. "Downtown Kitchener")

municipality.description: The municipality of the neighborhood (e.g. "Kitchener", "Waterloo", etc.)

lat.description: Latitude coordinate of the neighborhood center

lng.description: Longitude coordinate of the neighborhood center

kind.description: Whether it is a standard neighborhood or community area

id.description: Optional custom ID. If omitted, will be auto-generated from the label.

previousPrice.description: Previous benchmark home price in CAD ($)

tools.name: update_neighborhood
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Update a neighborhood by ID. Response always includes benchmark price, DOM, and previousPrice (n/a if unset).

id.description: The unique ID of the neighborhood to update

label.description: Updated display name of the neighborhood

price.description: Updated benchmark home price in CAD ($)

previousPrice.description: Updated previous benchmark home price in CAD ($)

tools.name: delete_neighborhood
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Delete a neighborhood from the catalog by its ID.

id.description: The unique ID of the neighborhood to delete

tools.name: rebuild_neighborhood_score_samples
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Rebuild the score samples for specified radii (e.g. 1, 3, 5, 8, or 10 km) in the Waterloo Region to update the Local Food Score map coloring.

radii.description: List of radii in kilometers to rebuild. Defaults to all radii: [1, 3, 5, 8, 10].

tools.name: discover_neighborhood_candidates
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Discover food-related OSM locations (restaurants, cafes, specialty food shops) in a neighborhood, filtering out ignored franchise names and already imported places. Returns clean candidates for sourcing verification.

neighborhood_id.description: The unique ID of the neighborhood (e.g. uptown-waterloo)

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers around the neighborhood center (default: 1.5, min: 0.5, max: 5.0)

custom_ignore_names.description: Optional additional business names to ignore during discovery

tools.name: apply_association
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Link a participant (farm, restaurant, market) to an association (like EFAO or WRCGN).

participant_id.description: The ID of the participant (place) to link

association_id.description: The ID of the association (e.g., EFAO ID)

tools.name: remove_association
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Remove a link between a participant and an association.

tools.name: create_pack_price
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED (place owner or admin): Add how a STAPLE offering is sold — total price for a pack size. Examples: offering_id + pack_qty=10 + pack_unit=kg; or pack_qty=1 + pack_unit=eighth (beef share). Optional source_url = online shop page for that pack. Prefer offering_id. Use list_pack_prices to inspect; update_pack_price / delete_pack_price to fix mistakes.

offering_id.description: STAPLE offering ID (required for farm sell packs)

category.description: Optional plate category when no offering_id (admin bulk)

total_price_cad.description: Total CAD charged for this pack

pack_qty.description: Amount in the pack (e.g. 10 for 10 kg; 1 for one eighth)

pack_unit.description: kg, lb, eighth, quarter, half, whole, dozen, each, L, g (e.g. 10 kg or 1 eighth of beef)

scale.description: Defaults from offering type or local_bulk

source_url.description: Optional URL of the online shop / product page where this pack is sold (shop link)

tools.name: list_pack_prices
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: List pack/sell-price quotes (includes source_url shop link when set). Filter by place, offering_id, category, quote_id, or fresh_only. Pass include_paused=true to see paused packs (farmer view).

quote_id.description: Fetch a single quote by ID

tools.name: update_pack_price
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED (place owner or admin): Update a pack price quote. Use is_active=false to pause; true to resume. Optional source_url = online shop page for that pack (pass empty string to clear). Use list_pack_prices for quote_id; delete_pack_price to remove permanently.

source_url.description: Online shop / product page URL for this pack. Pass empty string to clear.

is_active.description: false = pause this sell pack; true = resume

tools.name: delete_pack_price
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED (place owner or admin): Permanently delete a pack price when you no longer sell that pack (or it was added by mistake). Prefer is_active=false (pause) if you may resume later.

tools.name: search_recipes
tools.description: Search public published recipes (or your own with mine=true). Filter by cuisine slug, region, diet, meal, or free-text query.

mine.description: 🔐 If true, list recipes you own (includes drafts)

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Get a recipe by ID (UUID/cuid). Drafts require ownership or admin.

tools.name: list_cuisines
tools.description: List cuisine tags for recipes (id, slug, label). Use IDs with create_recipe / update_recipe.

tools.name: create_recipe
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Create a crowdsourced recipe. Defaults to DRAFT. Link ingredients to catalog via product_id when known.

ingredients.description: Ingredients (replaces all on update when provided)

step_image_urls.description: Photo URL per cooking step (same order as steps)

cuisine_ids.description: Up to 3 cuisine IDs from list_cuisines

association_id.description: Optional association ID to attribute this recipe to

owner_user_id.description: Admin only: assign a different owner user ID

tools.name: update_recipe
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Update a recipe you own (or any recipe if admin). Providing ingredients or cuisine_ids replaces those lists entirely.

ingredients.description: Ingredients (replaces all on update when provided)

step_image_urls.description: Photo URL per cooking step (same order as steps)

cuisine_ids.description: Up to 3 cuisine IDs from list_cuisines

association_id.description: Optional association ID to attribute this recipe to

owner_user_id.description: Admin only: assign a different owner user ID

tools.name: delete_recipe
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Permanently delete a recipe you own (or any if admin).

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search job and volunteer postings. Public. Filter by place, text, employment type, or location. Use before create_job to avoid duplicates.

status.description: Default ACTIVE. Use all when checking for existing postings.

tools.name: create_job
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Create a job or volunteer posting for a place. Admins may post for any place; owners/admins of a place may post for that place. ONLY when a website or official posting names this opening — copy published words. Do not invent jobs.

expires_at.description: ISO date or datetime when the posting closes

radius_km.description: How far job seekers can see this posting (default 2)

required_skills.description: Skill names from the jobs catalog (e.g. Farming, Sales)

optional_skills.description: Skill names from the jobs catalog (e.g. Farming, Sales)

tools.name: update_job
tools.description: 🔐 AUTHENTICATED: Update or expire a job posting. Admins may edit any job; place owners/admins may edit their own. Set status CANCELLED or FILLED when the opening closes.

expires_at.description: ISO date/datetime, or empty to clear

required_skills.description: Skill names from the jobs catalog (e.g. Farming, Sales)

optional_skills.description: Skill names from the jobs catalog (e.g. Farming, Sales)

tools.name: list_associations
tools.description: List associations (id, slug, name). Authenticated. Use before create_place_tour or apply_association.

tools.name: create_association
tools.description: 🔐 ADMIN ONLY: Create an association. Use when the org does not already exist. Do not invent names.

tools.name: list_place_tours
tools.description: List drafts and published walking tours for an association you can manage. Returns tours and member places for stops.

slug.description: Association slug if id is unknown

tools.name: create_place_tour
tools.description: Create a draft walking tour for an association you can manage. Title must not copy the association name. Stops via set_place_tour_stops. Narration is on each place (update_place tourNarration).

slug.description: Association slug if id is unknown

tools.name: update_place_tour
tools.description: Update a tour you can manage. Set status PUBLISHED when stops are ready. Public pages still need the Place Tours feature flag.

slug.description: Association slug if id is unknown

tools.name: set_place_tour_stops
tools.description: Replace tour stops in order. participant_ids are Piknik place ids. Does not require membership, but dashboard stop picker lists members.

slug.description: Association slug if id is unknown
